      About this product

      Rehamo’s Steely Econo is an affordable wheelchair that is easy to port and becomes easier for the users to move around. The wheelchair comes with a foldable frame and is made of M-Steel. Half removable backrest of the wheelchair shows the transport feature, with nylon upholstery for the user’s comfort. The textured handrim on the wheelchair helps in providing better propulsion of the product for the user. Large castor wheels of Steely Econo give the user a smoother ride, enabling easier maneuverability. The maximum user capacity of the product is 100 kg.
